notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Folio of Fancies's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, creating a Treasure token for each player who can't pay {2}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any colors.
Repeat.
